items.example: I can't afford a new phone right now.
items.exampleTr: Şu an yeni bir telefona param yetmez.
items.simple: If you can afford something, you have enough money to buy it.

items.example: It looks nice, but I can't afford it.
items.simple: You want to buy it, but you don't have enough money.

items.example: Only five pounds? It's a bargain!
items.simple: The price is very low for a good thing.

items.example: Ten pounds for a coffee? What a rip-off!
items.exampleTr: Bir kahve on pound mı? Ne kazık!
items.simple: A rip-off costs much more money than it should.

items.example: That's a rip-off. I'm not paying that.
items.simple: You say this when the price is too high and not fair.

items.example: I'm saving up for a new bike.
items.exampleTr: Yeni bir bisiklet için para biriktiriyorum.
items.simple: You keep a little money each day until you have enough for something big.

items.example: We're on a tight budget this month.
items.simple: A budget is a plan for how much money you can spend.

items.example: I'll pay you back tomorrow, I promise.
items.simple: You give money back to the person who gave it to you.

items.example: He's in a lot of debt.
items.simple: Debt is money you must give back to someone.

items.example: We cook at home to save money.
items.exampleTr: Para biriktirmek için evde yemek yapıyoruz.
items.simple: You don't spend all your money. You keep some.

items.example: Here's twenty. Keep the change.
items.simple: You tell the person to keep the small money you don't need back.

items.example: It's nice, but it's a bit pricey.
items.simple: It costs more money than you want to pay.

items.example: He spends too much money on games.
items.simple: You use your money to buy something.

items.example: I'd rather save than spend it all.
items.simple: You like one thing more than the other thing.

items.example: How much does it cost to get in?
items.simple: You ask this to find out the price.

items.example: The trip was expensive, but it's worth every penny.
items.exampleTr: Gezi pahalıydı ama her kuruşuna değdi.
items.simple: It was so good that the money you paid was fine.

items.example: Everything in this shop is overpriced.
items.exampleTr: Bu dükkandaki her şey fahiş fiyatlı.
items.simple: Something that costs more money than it is really worth.

items.example: I bought a second-hand bike.
items.simple: Someone else used it before you.

items.example: He took out a loan to buy a car.
items.simple: Money a bank gives you, and you must give it back later.

items.example: I have a coupon for free coffee.
items.simple: A small paper that makes something cost less.

items.example: We splashed out on a nice dinner.
items.exampleTr: Güzel bir akşam yemeği için bol bol harcadık.
items.simple: You spend lots of money on something fun.

items.tr: Daha ucuz bir şey var mı?
items.example: Is there anything cheaper than this?
items.exampleTr: Bundan daha ucuz bir şey var mı?
items.simple: You ask for something that costs less money.
